causeLimit: The retained first failure is the deterministic prepare-testing implementation_exception. Its retained diagnostic is generic; selected event rows and final native owner value contain no underlying exception text. Root owns causal triangulation. No application-test red or provider failure is inferred.

jobFidelity.reason: Specification, feature-decomposition and module-design are present and are reused. The next missing source stages are implementation-design.md and component-code-surface.md, which fix exact files, the core-only DTO placement and the executable proof plan. They are the shortest prerequisite before building a runnable SBT tenant.

jobFidelity.scope: qualification + main Scala/SBT; test specs/qualification/mutation/restoration/archive/release later; no self-compile proof

processExitObservation.meaning: No matching processes in exact scoped ps snapshot; no global containment claim

limitations: No C2 command execution or independent native UAT assessment reached.
No compiled test, eight report, depth, mutation/red/restoration or app-completion proof earned.
Physical authored changes are bounded partial progress; producer reports retain unmet parent obligations.
No formal churn/yield ledger or timeout-stop proof claimed; run closed before the common five-hour deadline.
No recovery, private events, source edits, app repair, retry or later-case dispatch performed.

eventStore.meaning: Exact scoped process absence plus unchanged event-store stat across final hash; no global containment or future-quiescence claim.

summary.reason: Original application obligations or terminal evidence remain incomplete

firstFailureChain.nextReason: The realized tenant now exists, but whether it loads offline and compiles has not been observed. Every downstream increment depends on that: the test design binding to the API, the specs, the original run, repair, mutation, and the time budget. One registered `sbt test` probe against the current files settles it for the cost of one run, using only existing files and the registered plan. If the build is broken, construction repairs it before tests are written against a bad API. If it compiles, test-design.md proceeds on confirmed ground.
